_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
I ye jokelani {player_id}, i b'a don {num_rounds} bukari Iterated Ultimatum Game.
I ye ${pool} ko k'a faga o bugun bukari ko, a ka jokelani {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - A faga dalilen: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ika dalilen ye, → I ye $(pool - X), jokelani kelen ye $X
  - Ika dalilen ma ye, → Aw ka ye $0
  - Seneko: [Offer: $3]  ni  'N'b'a faga ko dalilen. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - A faga dalilen ko ni [Accept] ni [Reject]
  - Seneko: 'A dalilen ko ye, [Accept]'
            'A dalilen ko ma ye, [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Bukari {round_number} ye! ---
Jokelani {proposer_id} ye proposer, jokelani {responder_id} ye responder.
round.offer: Bukari {round_number}: Jokelani {proposer_id} faga ${offer} jokelani {responder_id} (a ka ye ${keep}).
round.accepted: Jokelani {responder_id} ye dalilen! Bukari {round_number}: Jokelani {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, jokelani {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jamana ko sira: Jokelani 0: ${total_0}, Jokelani 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Jokelani {responder_id} ma ye dalilen! Bukari {round_number}: Aw ka ye $0. Jamana ko sira: Jokelani 0: ${total_0}, Jokelani 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: O ka kan k'a kɛ ni [Offer: $X] ye.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Sigiyɔrɔ sɔngɔ ka kan ka kɛ jatiden dafalen ye.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Oferisi bɛ kan ka kɛ $0 ani ${pool} cɛ.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Bi laseli tɛ sɔrɔ min ka kan ni jaabi ye.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder y'a faga [Accept] ni [Reject] k'a dalilen.

outcome.win: Jokelani {winner} ye jigi ko ${winner_total} jamana ko, ko jokelani {loser} ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: O don na, u fila bɛɛ ye wari ${total} sɔrɔ.
